description:
The twentieth and last case of this folder, and the one that carries gate G37 and rule R6: the whole conversation state travels in the payload and none of it is held on the server. A regular user signs on successfully - USER0005, the tenth seeded row - while carrying an inbound CARDDEMO-COMMAREA populated in every one of its five sub-groups, and the assertion is the split that produces: the five fields :224-228 writes are overwritten, and the eleven fields COSGN00C never touches come back byte for byte exactly as they arrived. It is the complement of case14, which carries a populated area across the rejecting wrong-password ELSE at :241-246. This one carries one across the signing-on path, where the program does write into the area, so the two together show the pass-through holding on both sides of the comparison at :223 - and the signing-on side is the harder of the two, because it is the only side on which a translation that rebuilt the area instead of copying it could still produce the five correct values.

The five that are overwritten, each with the line that writes it: CDEMO-FROM-TRANID becomes CC00 at :224 from WS-TRANID at :37; CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM becomes COSGN00C at :225 from WS-PGMNAME at :36; CDEMO-USER-ID becomes USER0005 at :226, having already been written unconditionally at :134; CDEMO-USER-TYPE becomes U at :227, straight out of the SEC-USR-TYPE of the row read; and CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT becomes 0 at :228 by MOVE ZEROS, which asserts 88 CDEMO-PGM-ENTER. The eleven that are preserved are each pinned individually, against the value they arrived carrying, rather than as one blanket claim that nothing else changed: CDEMO-TO-TRANID CCLI, CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM COCRDLIC, CDEMO-CUST-ID 000000817, CDEMO-CUST-FNAME GRACE and CDEMO-CUST-MNAME B and CDEMO-CUST-LNAME HOPPER each at their full PIC X(25) width with the trailing spaces intact, CDEMO-ACCT-ID 00000000817, CDEMO-ACCT-STATUS N, CDEMO-CARD-NUM 5555444433332222, and CDEMO-LAST-MAP COUSR0A with CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET COUSR00 - both PIC X(7) and not X(8), which is the easiest width in this copybook to get wrong by assuming it matches the eight-character program and mapset names around it. Only an explicit pair per field catches an implementation that zeroed or re-initialised the area, because a blanket assertion is equally satisfied by a rebuilt area that happens to be empty on both sides of the call.

The widths are taken from app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:19-44 and sum to the area's declared length rather than being asserted to: CDEMO-GENERAL-INFO is 4 + 8 + 4 + 8 + 8 + 1 + 1 = 34, CDEMO-CUSTOMER-INFO is 9 + 25 + 25 + 25 = 84, CDEMO-ACCOUNT-INFO is 11 + 1 = 12, CDEMO-CARD-INFO is 16, and CDEMO-MORE-INFO is 7 + 7 = 14, so 34 + 84 + 12 + 16 + 14 = 160 - which is what :101 hands over as LENGTH OF CARDDEMO-COMMAREA and what EIBCALEN therefore reports at :80 on a re-entry. The arithmetic is written out here so a reviewer can diff it against the copybook by eye instead of trusting it, and every value above was space padded or zero filled to its declared PICTURE width by computation rather than typed out and counted.

Four of the five overwrites arrive holding a different value, which is what stops this case being satisfied by an implementation that merely copied the area straight through. CDEMO-FROM-TRANID arrives CU00 and CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM arrives COUSR00C - transaction CU00 is COUSR00C at app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:449-450 - so a translation that skipped :224 and :225 would hand the stale pair back and be caught. CDEMO-USER-ID arrives ADMIN002, which is deliberately a real and different key in the seeded set rather than a nonsense one: an implementation that keyed the read at :211-219 off the inbound area instead of off USERIDI would read row 1, find SEC-USR-TYPE A, and leave by the administrator target at :232 instead of the regular-user target at :237, which this case reports rather than passes. CDEMO-USER-TYPE arrives A for the same reason - if :227 did not run, the type left in the area would still be A and the transfer would resolve to the administrator arm of :230. The fifth is stated plainly rather than glossed: CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives 0 and leaves 0, so on this case alone the overwrite at :228 is not distinguishable from preservation. COSGN00C never moves 1 into that field anywhere - only ZEROS at :228 - so this program's first-entry-versus-re-entry discriminator is EIBCALEN at :80 and not the program-context flag, and the proof that the reset is conditional on the matching branch of :223 belongs to case15, which arrives at the 88 CDEMO-PGM-REENTER value, is refused, and leaves with it unchanged. case15 stays the only case in the twenty that arrives with a non-zero program context.

CDEMO-TO-TRANID and CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM arrive naming a target this program never reads - CCLI, which is COCRDLIC at app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:357-358 - and they are still naming it on the way out. That choice is what makes the transfer assertion sharp: the target pinned here is COMEN01C, the literal at :237, and because the inbound area names a different program the case proves the target came from that literal and not from CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM. COSGN00C writes neither TO field on any path, so a translation that helpfully populated them from its own transfer target would be caught here as a difference on two fields rather than passing quietly.

Nothing is retained between invocations. The area arrives in the request and leaves in the response, so common.NavigationContext replaces server-side session state outright: this case declares no session identifier, no cookie, no cache key, no static holder and no HttpSession, because the design leaves nowhere for one to live. The harness asserts the same property a second and independent way, by constructing two separate triples from the same payload and requiring their outcomes to be equal - a user, a role or a screen cached between requests would make the second run differ and be reported here rather than found later.

USRSEC is seeded from app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:35-44, whose ten in-stream rows are 57 characters where app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy:17-23 declares 80: SEC-USR-ID X(08) at 0, SEC-USR-FNAME X(20) at 8, SEC-USR-LNAME X(20) at 28, SEC-USR-PWD X(08) at 48, SEC-USR-TYPE X(01) at 56 - which is 57 - then SEC-USR-FILLER X(23) at 57, which is 80. The 23-byte shortfall is supplied once at seed time by the declared USRSEC_FILLER_PAD_57_TO_80 normalisation and never hand-padded, and the 80-character expectedFinalState images prove that span was emitted as 23 spaces - a record missing it would be short by exactly 23. Row 9, the row WS-USER-ID addresses on this run and the one row no other case in the folder pins, is additionally pinned span by span so that a difference is reported against a field name and not only against a record image: SEC-USR-ID USER0005, SEC-USR-FNAME LEE followed by seventeen spaces, SEC-USR-LNAME TING followed by sixteen spaces, SEC-USR-PWD PASSWORD, SEC-USR-TYPE U, and SEC-USR-FILLER as its 23 spaces - six named spans summing to 8 + 20 + 20 + 8 + 1 + 23 = 80. Those are the shortest names in the seeded set, which makes this row the padding complement of case19's GRANVILLE LACHAPELLE: between them the two bracket the range a PIC X(20) move has to fill, from four characters of padding to seventeen. The same job corroborates the target width twice, with DCB=(LRECL=80,RECFM=FB) on SYSUT2 and KEYS(8,0) with RECORDSIZE(80,80) on the INDEXED cluster at :65-68. The dataset is addressed by its binding key USRSEC - the CICS file name at :39 - and never by a dataset name. expectedWrites is empty as a positive assertion: COSGN00C contains no WRITE, REWRITE or DELETE on any path, and the read at :211-219 does not even specify UPDATE, so it takes no lock and holds no record. expectedReturnCode is 0 because grep -c RETURN-CODE over the program is 0.

No screen is sent on this path, and both empty members say so positively rather than by omission. :230-239 leaves by EXEC CICS XCTL, so SEND-SIGNON-SCREEN at :145-157 is never performed, POPULATE-HEADER-INFO at :177-204 is never reached, and there is therefore no ERRMSG line and no projection of the eleven named items of mapset COSGN00 at all: sends is empty and expectedMessages is empty. WS-ERR-FLG is still N, the value SET ERR-FLG-OFF gives it at :74 - the EVALUATE TRUE at :117-130 fell through to WHEN OTHER and CONTINUE because both typed fields are present, so nothing set the flag, and IF NOT ERR-FLG-ON at :138 therefore performed READ-USER-SEC-FILE. The two message literals this program can emit are not involved: CCDA-MSG-THANK-YOU reaches WS-MESSAGE only from the DFHPF3 arm at :88-90 and CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY only from WHEN OTHER at :92-95, and this case presses DFHENTER, matching :86.

Determinism and the two substitutions, declared for consistency with the other nineteen even though this path consumes neither. The clock is pinned rather than read - 2022-07-19T23:12:33, traceable to this program's own version footer at :259 and expressed as a fixed local date-time so that no timezone can shift it - because POPULATE-HEADER-INFO opens with MOVE FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE TO WS-CURDATE-DATA at :179 and any case that reached it would need the value fixed. APPLID and SYSID come from EXEC CICS ASSIGN at :198-204, which has no Java equivalent and which neither application.yml nor application-test.yml binds, so CICSAWS1 and AWS1 space padded to PIC X(8) are pinned constants standing in for those two calls; all twenty cases use the same pair, and the substitution is stated here rather than hidden. The charset is named explicitly as US-ASCII instead of being left to a platform default. Nothing in this case depends on a wall clock, on randomness, or on the order in which the twenty run.

Two deviations, documented rather than silently corrected. app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl:59 is *COPY DFHATTR. with the asterisk in column 7, which makes it a COBOL comment and not an include: no DFHATTR constant is in effect for this program, so none is named anywhere here. COSGN00C does not copy CSSETATY either - its only consumer in the repository is COACTUPC, with 39 textual occurrences there and zero here - so there is no runtime attribute assignment to carry and no DFHRED or '*' highlight to reproduce, a point this path makes twice over since it sends no screen at all.

Provenance. Every expected value above is statically derived - by structured reading of app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl cross-checked against app/cpy/CSUSR01Y.cpy for the record layout, app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy for the communication area and its 88-levels, app/cpy-bms/COSGN00.CPY with app/bms/COSGN00.bms for the screen field shapes, app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD for transactions CC00, CU00 and CCLI, and app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:35-44 for the ten seed rows. It was never captured from, recorded against or replayed from a live COBOL execution, which is empirically impossible in this environment: there is no z/OS or CICS runtime, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled, no Language Environment CEE* services exist, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository. Only the provenance of the expected values is substituted; the twenty cases, the field-for-field diffing and the diff-count-equals-zero gate all stand, and the substitution is escalated for confirmation rather than absorbed.

The unit is SignOnService, driven as a plain object with a fixture-backed SecUserRepository, and the response is projected by SignOnController, also a plain object - no MockMvc, no HTTP, no servlet container and no JobLauncher anywhere in the path, which is what lets this case assert the arithmetic-free decision logic directly. The repository reports the NORMAL outcome that the seeded row produces, so no outcome is forced: EVALUATE WS-RESP-CD at :221 matches WHEN 0 on the data rather than on an instruction. The password stays the plaintext PASSWORD because :223 compares it in plaintext; that is an inherited property of the legacy design and an explicit non-goal of this migration, so there is no hashing, no salt, no encoder, no token and no filter chain anywhere here. Neither the backward-GO TO restructuring gate nor the abend gate applies: grep -c "GO TO" and grep -c CEE3ABD over app/cbl/COSGN00C.cbl are both 0, and neither is faked.
